visual_goal: Show FOCUS data landed and enriched in FinDB, accounting decisions made in a posting service with versioned rules, and one cut-off snapshot feeding both the journals and the tie-out.
prompt: A left-to-right pipeline. At the far left a stack of three plain clouds labeled 'FOCUS data', with one arrow into a large cylinder 'FinDB' that has three thin bands on it (land, conform, enrich drawn as bands, no text). One arrow from 'FinDB' into a box 'Posting service' with a small rule-book icon. Inside or right after it, a camera-shutter icon labeled 'Snapshot', with one arrow from 'Posting service' into it. From 'Snapshot' two arrows: one up-right into a stack of journal pages labeled 'Journals', and one down-right into a box 'Tie-out' with a balance-scale icon. From 'Journals' one arrow right into an open book 'S/4HANA' and one arrow up-right into a box 'Intercompany'. A document stack 'Invoices' sits at the bottom left with one long arrow into 'Tie-out'. One arrow from 'S/4HANA' down into 'Tie-out'. One arrow from 'Tie-out' right into a box with a check mark 'BlackLine'. Exactly ten arrows.
alt: FOCUS data lands in FinDB, a posting service takes one snapshot that feeds both the journals posted to S/4HANA and intercompany, and a tie-out with invoices and the ledger whose evidence goes to BlackLine.

visual_goal: Show the allocation hierarchy: account structure as primary key, tags validated against finance masters, then two separate decisions, natural account and route by legal entity.
prompt: A top-to-bottom tree. At the top a box 'Billing account', one arrow down to a box 'Sub-account'. From 'Sub-account' two arrows down: left to a ledger-card icon 'Register', right to a bundle of tag icons 'Tags'. From 'Tags' one arrow into a checkpoint gate with a check mark and a cross labeled 'Finance masters'. One arrow from 'Register' and one arrow from the gate converge into a wide box 'Dimensions'. From 'Dimensions' two arrows fork down: left into a signpost labeled 'Natural account', right into a diamond labeled 'Same entity?'. From the diamond two arrows: one to a box 'Cost-center charge' with a small green check, one to a box 'Intercompany recharge' with two small buildings. Exactly ten arrows.
alt: A tree from billing account to sub-account, then register and tags validated against finance masters converging on dimensions, which fork into the natural account decision and a same-entity check that routes to a cost-center charge or an intercompany recharge.

visual_goal: Show the month-end sequence: one snapshot at cut-off produces accrual, amortization and recharges, the invoice arrives later, and BlackLine ties out the same snapshot's totals against the ledger.
prompt: A left-to-right horizontal timeline ribbon with two dated markers: '1 October' at the left and '2 October' further right. At '1 October' a camera-shutter icon labeled 'Snapshot' sits above a box 'Posting service', with one arrow from 'Snapshot' down into it. From 'Posting service' three parallel arrows go right into a large open book 'S/4HANA', each arrow carrying a small journal page labeled 'Accrual', 'Amortization' and 'Recharges'. At '2 October', directly below the open book, a document 'Invoice' with one short arrow pointing straight up into the open book 'S/4HANA'. At the far right a box with a balance-scale icon labeled 'BlackLine' receives exactly two arrows: one long arrow from 'Snapshot' arching over the top of the image, and one from the right side of 'S/4HANA'. Exactly seven arrows.
alt: A timeline: on 1 October one snapshot feeds a posting service that posts accrual, amortization and recharge journals to S/4HANA; the invoice arrives on 2 October; BlackLine ties out the snapshot totals against the ledger.
